Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class SinglesColumnGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.SinglesColumnGameTests
public final class SinglesColumnGameTests extends Object
Singles support and gravity in a live level: grounding at the bottom of a column, a cell resting on the one below it, visual columns lining up across differently rotated blocks, and extraction shifting a column down while carrying each item's rotation with it.
